name: flame-chaser
description: Curio monorepo tooling: commit convention (commitizen + commitlint) and git hooks. App code lives in deliverer/ and reaver/.

scripts.prepare: husky || echo 'no .git yet: run `pnpm prepare` after git init'
scripts.check: pnpm --filter deliverer run check && cd reaver && ./check.sh && cd .. && scripts/check-version.sh && scripts/check-dash.sh
